name: Apify
description: Optional hosted social-media collection through Apify actors (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn) via the Apify REST API. Activated only when APIFY_API_TOKEN is set; the Engine injects it when Apify is enabled in Indicator Labs, from-repo users export it themselves.
rate_limit_note: Pay-per-result actor pricing billed to the member's own Apify account; cap every run with maxItems. Platform ToS caveat: X prohibits scraping even public posts, so Apify collection on X is a ToS-violating path — record the collection authority in access_notes and prefer the official API or a licensed broker where legal scrutiny is likely.
